evidence.why: Command clear, helper-before-guard ordering, cleanup placement, and independent completion test.
Unguarded reciprocal capture accesses and hardcoded state 0x153.

facts.rationale: Replaces the baseline's unconditional null-victim cleanup claim with the actual caller ordering and cross-file preconditions while preserving one-shot command consumption and the independent completion branch.
facts.value: A nonzero cmd_vars[0] is cleared before invoking ftCh_GrabUnk1_8015B850(victim_gobj, 0x153). The subsequent non-null victim guard protects only the common capture/throw/thrown calls, not that earlier helper. The earlier helper dereferences the supplied fighter and its reciprocal victim without guards and hardcodes state 0x153 despite accepting a motion-ID parameter. Thus null-victim execution and later x20 cleanup are not guaranteed safe. If preceding calls return normally, x20 is cleared outside the later victim guard. Independently, animation exhaustion invokes ftCh_GrabUnk1_8015BC88 whether or not the command event occurred.
